altGroupKey.@Common.Label: Alt-group key
altGroupKey.@Common.QuickInfo: Items in this path with the same (key, order) form a pick-one alt-group. Leave blank for linear backbone.

altGroupLabel.@Common.Label: Alt-group label
altGroupLabel.@Common.QuickInfo: Display text on the alt-group chip (e.g. "HANA Cloud", "On-prem"). Required when key is set.

altCondition.@Common.Label: Alt-group condition
altCondition.@Common.QuickInfo: Optional predicate (e.g. profile.deployment == 'cloud'). When set, runtime evaluates deterministically; when null, the heuristic ranker decides.

altGroupKey.@Common.Label: Alt-group key
altGroupKey.@Common.QuickInfo: Items in this group with the same (key, order) form a pick-one alt-group. Leave blank for linear backbone.

altGroupLabel.@Common.Label: Alt-group label
altGroupLabel.@Common.QuickInfo: Display text on the alt-group chip (e.g. "HANA Cloud", "On-prem"). Required when key is set.

altCondition.@Common.Label: Alt-group condition
altCondition.@Common.QuickInfo: Optional predicate (e.g. profile.deployment == 'cloud'). When set, runtime evaluates deterministically; when null, the heuristic ranker decides.

enabled.@Common.Label: Enabled
enabled.@description: Master kill-switch. When off, the Joule button is hidden and /chat/stream returns 503.

deploymentId.@Common.Label: AI Core Deployment ID
deploymentId.@description: Orchestration deployment from SAP AI Core Generative AI Hub.

modelName.@Common.Label: Model Name
modelName.@description: Foundation model name routed by the orchestration deployment (e.g. anthropic--claude-4.6-sonnet, gpt-4.1). Leave blank for server default.

temperature.@Common.Label: Temperature
temperature.@description: Sampling temperature 0.00 (deterministic) to 1.00 (creative). Leave blank for server default (0.51).

maxTokens.@Common.Label: Max Tokens
maxTokens.@description: Cap on tokens in a single assistant response. Leave blank for server default (10025).

maxRequestsPerUser.@Common.Label: Max Requests / User / Day
maxRequestsPerUser.@description: In-memory rolling 24h limit, per service instance. Effective ceiling = this × instance count.

bannerText.@Common.Label: Banner Text
bannerText.@description: Optional notice shown above the chat input (e.g. "Joule is in beta").

isActive.@Common.Label: Active
isActive.@Core.Description: Exactly one config can be active at a time. Flipping this on will deactivate the previous active row.
